name: list_projects
description: List the ChatCut projects this signed-in user owns or can access, newest first. Machine-readable results are an object with structuredContent.projects[]; each row uses projectId (not id), name, thumbnailUrl, and an editorUrl when the current surface supports web links. This is a discovery-only call: it does not bind the external MCP session or retarget the live editor/browser surface. Call target_project with the chosen projectId before using project editing tools, or get_editor_url/create_project when a project should be opened visibly. Returns only the authenticated user's own projects. Soft-deleted projects are excluded unless includeDeleted=true (they carry deletionState and can be brought back with restore_project).

editorBaseUrl.description: Editor origin/base URL for the returned URLs. Defaults to CHATCUT_EDITOR_URL or http://localhost:5173.

includeDeleted.description: Also list soft-deleted projects (marked with deletionState) so they can be restored with restore_project. Defaults to false.

installationReceipt.description: Only when the hosted plugin's installation guide left a pending local installation receipt: pass its code unchanged to connect that installation with its landing-page entry. Never invent a code. Omit for ordinary project discovery and ChatCut Desktop. Invalid values are ignored, and a pending acknowledgment never prevents project use.
